additional_info.subject: ID0474238-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313483122003] CU Logs Check CRM:00263000391
additional_info.body:
Hi guys, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I found an error in this charger where the AC contactor for the AC outlet didn't close in some sessions but it's no longer present:
There has been several sessions after this reported error, so I'm not sure what you prefer to do here, from my POV there can only be 3 reasons:
Feedback opened (13-14)
A1-A2 lost voltage supply
L1/L2/L3/L4 (main contactor) opened
Please let me know what you think, should I send this to your queue for a site visit? I know you guys have SLA contract and maybe it doesn't make sense to go there if the error is no longer present, but at least let me know what I should tell the customer or even if I send you the ticket and you convey the message and close the ticket?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
